title: P2-S3 amendment context: readiness string drift + real-SDK worker contract
body: Context for the P2-S3 amendment (real hatchet_sdk-1.38.1 worker contract). (1) QA Round 2 (qa-reviewer L20) PLANNING_GAP: cli.py:116-120 does getattr(client,'worker',None) then getattr(worker,'start',None); in pinned hatchet_sdk-1.38.1 Hatchet.worker is a METHOD returning Worker, Worker.start() lives on the returned object, so loop-start is silently skipped and the container prints ready then exits (fake readiness, would false-READY wait-for-worker.sh). Fix: factory must collect client.task(wf_name)(handler) return values into WorkerHandle.registered_workflows; cli calls client.worker("umd-worker", workflows=handle.registered_workflows) then start(); readiness emitted only after start returns; never getattr(client,"worker",...). (2) READINESS STRING DRIFT: current hatchet.py worker_ready_line (lines 169-173) returns "worker started: {count} workflows, {count} executors bound ...", but plan Decision B (line 33 Note) and QA L20 both record the canonical string as EXACTLY "worker ready: registered {N} Hatchet workflows (candidate, pending Plan J live validation)" and wait-for-worker.sh:35 greps 'worker ready: registered'. Current source does not match the documented contract string — amendment must reconcile to the canonical form. (3) WorkerHandle currently has _stages (STAGE_ORDER) but NO registered_workflows; needs the collected BaseWorkflow list. (4) New hermetic SDK-shaped test must exercise client.worker(name, workflows=...) + exactly-once start; _RecordingClient (test line 164) lacks a worker(name, workflows=) surface and records start via .start() flag — needs an SDK-shaped path.

title: OCFL fresh-root startup defect: production wiring never bootstraps /data/ocfl; /v1/ready does not probe OCFL
body: Corpus evidence for the Docker E2E POST /v1/sources HTTP 500 on fresh /data/ocfl. Verified at source: (1) src/umd/api/entrypoints.py:19-21 build_source_store returns SourceStore(root=...) — the NON-bootstrapping constructor (docstring store.py:90 explicitly: plain SourceStore(root=...) ASSUMES an initialized root). (2) BOTH API (app_factory entrypoints.py:28) and worker (deploy/cli.py:82) construct via build_source_store on the SAME compose volume ocfl-data:/data/ocfl (compose.yaml:86,127). (3) docker-entrypoint.sh runs migrations only (UMD_RUN_MIGRATIONS_ON_START) — never bootstraps OCFL. (4) /v1/ready (api/routers/system.py:93-108) is a PROJECTION-rebuild gate only; it does NOT call deploy/startup.readiness_probe, so a fresh OCFL root reports ready. compose api healthcheck hits /v1/health (also not OCFL-aware). (5) Sanctioned bootstrap = SourceStore.create() (store.py:113-132): idempotent for a single caller, tolerates empty root, rejects non-empty non-OCFL (fail-closed StoreError); ocfl-py initialize() requires root dir ABSENT so create() rmdirs empty root first (exec-worker L1). RACE HAZARD: create() is NOT concurrency-safe — check-namaste/mkdir/rmdir/initialize sequence has no lock; API+worker racing on a fresh volume can collide (FileNotFoundError on rmdir or false 'non-empty; refusing to bootstrap' after the other initialize()). Any fix moving both API+worker to create() must coordinate bootstrap or harden create() against concurrent callers. TEST GAP: conftest.py:81 uses SourceStore.create but tests the hermetic store, not production wiring; test_api_contract.py:803 test_build_source_store_uses_configured_ocfl_root pre-bootstraps (line 760) then asserts build_source_store uses root directly — this is the 'already-initialized store' test the task says NOT to rely on and must be updated. No test reproduces a fresh production volume through build_source_store/app_factory. WORKFLOW: validation.yml docker-e2e up -d creates fresh ocfl-data volume; /v1/ready passes (projection gate); boundary E2E (line 413) first POST /v1/sources -> put_immutable on uninitialized root -> 500; persistence namaste check (line 441) would also catch it. NO ADR/ASR infra (decisions/ + requirements/ absent) — authority is DD/CONTRACTS/logs. TENSION to reconcile: task reports live Hatchet suite PASSES but boundary ingest 500s on 'never-initialized' root; worker also uses build_source_store and writes OCFL-backed evidence per debugger logs — caller should confirm boundary ingest is the first OCFL-writing path. Read-only; no recommendations.
